_comment: Issue #729 / ADR-0093, epic #716 change 4. Every test-shaped artefact under tests/ that run_suite.py's discovery does NOT reach. Each one must say what does run it (`invoked`, naming a file under .github/workflows/, deploy/ or bin/ that mentions it or its directory -- verified, not taken on trust), or record that nothing does (`debt`, with an owning issue, and it must only go down). A fixed item must be DELETED from this file: a stale entry fails the audit, because a file listing every problem the project ever had is a file nobody reads.

entries.reason: Verified passing before scheduling: a real dockerd in docker:dind, an unqualified -p 4566:80 landing on 127.0.0.1.

Clean-source install rehearsal, DoD condition 11. Needs a real git checkout -- a linked worktree's .git is a file pointing outside the container, which is why it must run from the CI checkout rather than a copied worktree.
Needs no Docker at all -- only the repo and a temporary control plane. It was reachable by CI the whole time and simply never wired up. Verified passing.

Deliberately outside discovery -- tests/live/ has no __init__.py so the gated suite cannot reach it, which its own docstring calls load-bearing because it makes live GitHub API calls. Wired to a daily non-gating workflow instead.
The suite runner itself. Discovery cannot reach it because discovery IS it.
